login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your phone number and password.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your manager.
login.brandTitle: Your whole farm at a glance
login.brandBody: Land, livestock, feed and finance in one system. See which field or herd every som was spent on.

otp.title: Verification code
otp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
otp.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
otp.useApp: Use the code from the app
otp.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned this on. Each code works once.
otp.recoveryUsed: You signed in with a recovery code. Codes left: {{count}}.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor protection
twoFactor.intro: Connect an authenticator app to protect your account.
twoFactor.required: Your role requires two-factor protection. Turn it on to continue.
twoFactor.step1: Install Google Authenticator or a similar app on your phone.
twoFactor.step2: Scan this QR code in the app.
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.manual: If you can't scan it, enter this key by hand:
twoFactor.keyCopyFailed: Could not copy. Write the key down by hand.
twoFactor.disableHint: To turn it off, enter a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryBody: If you lose this phone, each code below lets you sign in once. They will not be shown again. Without them, only your manager or the platform administrator can let you back in.
twoFactor.recoveryCopyFailed: Could not copy. Write the codes down by hand.
twoFactor.recoverySaved: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
twoFactor.recoveryFile: AgroPanel recovery codes. Each code works once.
twoFactor.replaceBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. The old phone stops working, and you connect the new one next. Other devices are signed out.
twoFactor.newCodesHint: The old codes stop working. Enter a code from your app, or one recovery code.
twoFactor.setupFailed: Could not start the setup. Try again.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common words and your phone number.
password.forcedBody: The password you were given is only for your first sign-in. To continue, choose a new one that only you know.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

invitations.title: Invitation to a farm
invitations.intro: Until you accept, this farm sees nothing about you.

signOut.unsentBody: They stay on this phone and go out only when you sign in here again. Nobody else can send them.
signOut.noSignalBody: Until there is signal, nobody can sign in on this phone, neither you nor a colleague. If someone still needs to record, stay signed in.

errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min, or ask your manager.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: This password is too long. Choose a shorter one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_PHONE: The password must not contain your phone number.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: Your account is blocked. Ask your farm manager.
errors.TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Your role requires two-factor protection, so it can't be turned off.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: You aren't connected to this farm.
